outcome.interpretation_limit: This identifies a missing relationship in the projection. It does not establish that any capability invocation was lost or that this gap caused repeated work.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Durable Environment capability events are not correlated to agent objectives in the capability projection
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: mncs-environment session event and capability-intelligence projection
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The session event vocabulary already records capability.invoked and invocation.completed with a provider request identity, while the prior capability projection read campaign evidence without joining those events to the current session objective or Environment identity.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Expose a read-only bounded event tail through the existing capability projection, pair invocation and completion by provider request identity, retain exact event references and current work context, omit raw arguments and results, and disclose tail truncation and unavailable measurements.
not_measured: whether this missing projection relationship affected earlier development decisions
cross-session recurrence of uncorrelated capability events
token usage, model identity, execution duration, or resource consumption

supporting_sources.observed_contract: The projection processes committed campaign observation records and has no session event-tail correlation section.

not_measured: whether invocation events in other sessions were difficult for agents to discover
whether adding the projection changes development outcomes
